description: "Play ..." by voice through Music Assistant (Spotify). Artist ("play Fleetwood Mac", "play some Radiohead"), song ("play Dreams by Fleetwood Mac"), playlist ("play my golden hour playlist", matched loosely against the library). End with "in the kitchen" / "on the amp" / "in the guest room" / "in the bedroom" to pick a speaker; otherwise it plays in the room of the device you spoke to (bedroom if typed). Pause, skip and volume are HA's built-in media commands.

variables.room_m: {{ said | regex_findall('^(.+?)\s+(?:in|on|through)\s+(?:the\s+)?(kitchen|living room amp|living room|lounge|amp|guest bedroom|guest room|spare room|master bedroom|bedroom)$') }}
variables.room: {% if room_m %}{% set r = room_m[0][1] %}{{ 'kitchen' if r == 'kitchen' else 'living_room' if r in ['living room amp','living room','lounge','amp'] else 'guest_bedroom' if r in ['guest bedroom','guest room','spare room'] else 'bedroom' }}{% endif %}
variables.here: {% set a = area_id(trigger.device_id) if trigger.device_id else 'bedroom' %}{{ a if a in players else 'bedroom' }}
variables.where: {{ '' if target_room == here else ' in ' ~ labels[target_room] if target_room != 'living_room' else ' on the amp' }}
variables.q: {{ room_m[0][0] | trim if room_m else said }}
variables.kind: {% if q in ['music','some music','something','anything','songs','some songs','my music'] %}resume{% elif q is search(' playlist$') %}playlist{% elif q is search('^(some |music by |songs by |the artist )') %}artist{% elif ' by ' in q %}track{% else %}any{% endif %}
variables.name: {% if kind == 'playlist' %}{{ q | regex_replace('^(my|the|our) ', '') | regex_replace(' playlist$', '') | trim }}{% elif kind == 'artist' %}{{ q | regex_replace('^(some |music by |songs by |the artist )', '') | regex_replace(' (music|songs)$', '') | trim }}{% elif kind == 'track' %}{{ q.rsplit(' by ', 1)[0] | regex_replace('^(the song |the track )', '') | trim }}{% else %}{{ q }}{% endif %}
variables.by: {{ q.rsplit(' by ', 1)[1] | trim if kind == 'track' else '' }}

data.name: {{ name }}
data.media_type: {{ ['track'] if kind == 'track' else ['artist'] if kind == 'artist' else ['playlist'] if kind == 'playlist' else ['artist', 'track', 'album'] }}
